title: Playground Series s6e5 — scripts source
subtitle: Python source modules for the s6e5 stacking pipeline (private)
description: Source .py files from the s6e5 project's scripts/ directory. Used by GPU kernels via sys.path.insert("/kaggle/input/s6e5-scripts") so they can reuse local helpers (p1_features, fold-safe TE, aux-target builders, probe utilities) without inlining 1500+ lines per kernel.
